name: DJ Symphonic: 80s & 90s Edition
description: The Royal Film Concert Orchestra combines with a DJ to perform pop and dance hits from the 1980s and 1990s at Coliseu Porto Ageas.
longDescription:
The Royal Film Concert Orchestra joins a DJ on stage for a concert focused on pop and dance hits from the 1980s and 1990s. The show takes place in the Sala Principal at Coliseu Porto Ageas.

The programme features symphonic arrangements of tracks by artists such as Queen, Daft Punk, ABBA, Michael Jackson, Bonnie Tyler, Darude, and Gigi D'Agostino, alongside medleys and remixes.

The performance starts at 21:00 on 31 January 2027. Individual tickets range from 30€ for the gallery to 65€ for orchestra seats, with private boxes priced at 300€ for six people. The show is rated for audiences aged 6 and older.
descriptionPt: A Royal Film Concert Orchestra junta-se a um DJ para tocar êxitos pop e de dança dos anos 80 e 90 no Coliseu Porto Ageas.
longDescriptionPt:
A Royal Film Concert Orchestra junta-se a um DJ em palco para um concerto centrado em êxitos de pop e dance music dos anos 80 e 90. O espetáculo decorre na Sala Principal do Coliseu Porto Ageas.

O programa inclui arranjos sinfónicos de temas de artistas como Queen, Daft Punk, ABBA, Michael Jackson, Bonnie Tyler, Darude e Gigi D'Agostino, além de medleys e remisturas.

O concerto começa às 21h00 do dia 31 de janeiro de 2027. Os bilhetes individuais custam entre 30€ (galeria) e 65€ (plateia), havendo camarotes para seis pessoas a 300€. O espetáculo destina-se a maiores de 6 anos.
